name: rtk

claimed.text: reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands
claimed.label: claimed

prompt_tokens.label: measured
prompt_tokens.text: sessions with the optimizer on sent fewer prompt tokens per request than sessions with it off; sessions differ, so this supports but does not prove the saving

cost.label: measured
cost.text: sessions with the tool on cost less than sessions with it off, beyond what chance explains; sessions differ, so this supports but does not prove the saving

evidence: Sessions with the tool on are compared with later sessions without it. Sessions differ in size and task, so this supports a conclusion but does not prove it.
